lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb4Ag2Cl12 (reduced formula Rb2AgCl6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ag centers coordinated by six Cl neighbors, while Rb centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Cl neighbors. The Ag octahedra share edges with one another, and Rb 12-vertex polyhedra share faces with Ag octahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic neighbor network.
